title: Stroboscopic stability of a Floquet chiral spin liquid beyond the folding frequency
summary: We study the two-step Floquet dynamics of the chiral $J_1$-$J_2$-$K$ Heisenberg model on the $4\times4$ torus, alternating its non-chiral Heisenberg part $H_{AF}$ and its chiral plaquette part $H_K$, at a parameter point where the static model hosts a quasi-degenerate, spectrally isolated chiral-spin-liquid (CSL) topological doublet. The one-period propagator is computed exactly in all symmetry sectors.
